== Description ==
'''SHA-300''' is the one of the many Shadow entities found within the [[Alpha & Shadowpocalypse]] modifier. He is the infected counterpart of  [[Mouth]].

== Behavior ==
'''SHA-300''' will act like the regular [[Mouth]], but it will give less reaction time and it will chase the player with a speed very close to the normal sprinting speed. Upon reaching room containing the '''Void Wall''', '''SHA-300''' will then go back to the main room, pretending that it is going to despawn, but after about 5 seconds, '''SHA-300''' will respawn behind the void wall, and will chase the player back to the main room, and upon reaching the previous room behind the main room, '''SHA-300''' will proceed back to the '''Void Wall''' where it will finally despawn.

== Strategy & Tips ==
* Keep your ears open once you see the subtitles "Something is blocking this door from opening..." and only start running back if you don't hear anything, since it might be [[SHA-2]] or [[SHA-4]] behind the door instead of '''SHA-300'''.
* As '''SHA-300''' is slightly slower than the sprinting speed of a player, so you should instantly start sprinting as much as possible in the opposite direction of '''SHA-300''' to have maximum distance from '''SHA-300'''.
** During the '''Alpha & Shadowpocalypse''' modifier, you should pick up all the stamina [[Items|Utilities]] you find, because they will be extremely effective against '''SHA-300'''.
* It is possible to survive '''SHA-300''' without using any utilities, but it is very risky, as you'll run out of stamina fast and will have to run back to the main room once you reach the '''Void Wall'''. So, if you don't have any [[Items|Utilities]], run to the '''Void Wall''' using as much stamina as possible, and upon reaching the '''Void Wall''', crouch to regain stamina quickly and sprint back to the main room.

== Trivia ==
* '''SHA-300''' is one of the only entities in the game to not use raycasting to detect players.
* '''SHA-300''' has a chance to immediately break the door instead of waiting for the player to interact with it.
* It is heavily recommended to deal with '''SHA-300''' in the A section, especially due to it being the second fastest mouth variant (behind M section mouth) plus no crawlspaces being in A section
* DEVOUR OST (Chase theme)
